zh-CN.title: 五夜星旋支持历史进度
items: 空间认领活动时会回溯过去五天的夜间聊天，并继承仍连续的观测进度
缩小活动奖励预览中的旋转星核，避免遮挡星空村庄与树木

en.title: Five Nights now recognizes recent progress
items: Claiming the event now checks the previous five evenings and carries forward an active observation streak
Rotating stars in the reward preview are smaller so the village and trees remain visible
